shared_elements: animals in profile with elongated beaks/heads (birds)
low-relief carving with figures standing out from a plain ground
composite arrangement of multiple creatures on one surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief figural carving with animal forms, including long-beaked bird-like heads in profile and hatched/chevron patterned bands used as filler or garment/plumage texture. However, A is a vertically stacked register composition of separate animals (crouching quadrupeds, a fox-like beast, a large bird at the base) on a rectangular slab, while B is a single centred anthropomorphic figure with wings and raised arms enclosed within a circular ring frame, a scheme with no counterpart in A.
